symptoms_en: Yellow to orange uredinial pustules arranged in parallel linear stripes on leaf blades
Yellow powdery spores rubbing off on fingers when touched
Chlorotic yellowing spreading along leaf veins
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की सतह पर समानांतर धारियों में पीले रंग के फफोले (Pustules)
उंगली से छूने पर पीला चूर्ण/पाउडर जैसा पदार्थ लगना
पत्तियों का पीला पड़ना व पत्तियों की नसों के साथ संक्रमण फैलना
differential_diagnosis: Brown Leaf Rust pustules are scattered randomly on the leaf surface, whereas Yellow Rust forms distinct linear stripes.
cultural_management: Adopt resistant cultivars recommended for northern plains (e.g., HD 3086, DBW 187, DBW 222)
Avoid excessive nitrogenous fertilization beyond Soil Test recommendations
Eradicate volunteer grass weed hosts around field borders
biological_organic_management: Foliar spray of Trichoderma viride or neem-based formulations at initial symptom onset

symptoms_en: Small, round to oval, brown pustules scattered randomly on leaf blades without forming stripes
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर भूरे रंग के छोटे, गोल या अंडाकार फफोले जो बिना किसी धारी के बेतरतीब बिखरे होते हैं
differential_diagnosis: Distinguished from Yellow Rust by random scattered distribution rather than linear stripes.
cultural_management: Grow recommended rust-resistant varieties.
biological_organic_management: Spray bio-formulations upon early detection.

symptoms_en: White to greyish powdery fungal patches on upper surface of leaves and leaf sheaths
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों और तनों की ऊपरी सतह पर सफेद या भूरे रंग के चूर्ण जैसे धब्बे
differential_diagnosis: Superficial white powdery growth on leaf surface, unlike internal pustules of rusts.
cultural_management: Avoid high crop density and excessive nitrogen application.
biological_organic_management: Foliar spray of wettable sulfur in compliant dosages.

symptoms_en: Partial conversion of wheat kernels into black powdery teliospore masses with fishy smell (trimethylamine)
symptoms_hi: दाने का आंशिक रूप से काले चूर्ण में बदलना और सड़ी मछली जैसी दुर्गंध आना
differential_diagnosis: Only partial browning/blackening of grain embryo, distinct from loose smut where whole earhead is destroyed.
cultural_management: Avoid excessive irrigation during flowering window in endemic areas.
biological_organic_management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride.

symptoms_en: Spindle-shaped / eye-shaped lesions on leaves with brown/dark margins and grey-white centers
Blackening of neck node causing empty chaffy panicles (Neck blast)
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर नाव या आंख के आकार के धब्बे जिनके किनारे भूरे और केंद्र स्लेटी-सफेद होते हैं
बालियों की गर्दन काली पड़ना जिससे दाने नहीं भरते (गर्दन तोड़ ब्लास्ट)
differential_diagnosis: Spindle-shaped lesions with ash-grey center are unique to blast, unlike rectangular brown spots of Helminthosporium.
cultural_management: Avoid excessive split application of nitrogen in blast-prone humid conditions.
biological_organic_management: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg.

symptoms_en: Water-soaked yellowish-green wavy lesions starting from leaf tip and margins progressing downwards
Bacterial ooze droplets visible on infected leaf margins in early morning
symptoms_hi: पत्ती के सिरे और किनारों से शुरू होकर नीचे की ओर बढ़ने वाले पीले-सफेद लहरदार धब्बे
सुबह के समय पत्ती के किनारों पर जीवाणु की चिपचिपी बूंदें दिखना
differential_diagnosis: Wavy margins and bacterial oozing distinguish BLB from fungal leaf streak.
cultural_management: Drain excess field water; avoid clipping seedling tips at transplanting.
biological_organic_management: Foliar application of fresh cow dung slurry extract (20%) or Pseudomonas fluorescens.

symptoms_en: Oval or snake-skin like greenish-grey spots on leaf sheaths near the water level with irregular margins
symptoms_hi: जल स्तर के पास तनों (शीथ) पर सांप की केंचुली जैसे स्लेटी-हरे अनियमित धब्बे
differential_diagnosis: Lesions originate at water line on leaf sheaths, unlike leaf blast occurring on foliage.
cultural_management: Maintain optimum plant spacing and balanced potash application to harden cell walls.
biological_organic_management: Soil application of Trichoderma viride enriched FYM.

symptoms_en: Individual grains transformed into large, velvety greenish-yellow spore balls which later turn orange-black
symptoms_hi: बालियों के अलग-अलग दानों का पीले-हरे मखमली गोलों में बदल जाना जो बाद में काले हो जाते हैं
differential_diagnosis: Velvety yellow balls on distinct grains, unlike bunt.
cultural_management: Avoid high nitrogen doses during flowering in high humidity regions.
biological_organic_management: Seed treatment before nursery raising.

symptoms_en: Water-soaked, irregular pale-green lesions turning dark brown to black rapidly on leaf tips and margins
White cottony fungal downy growth on the underside of infected leaves during humid mornings
Foul rotting odor in severely infected potato canopies
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों के सिरों व किनारों पर पानी से भीगे हुए अनियमित धब्बे जो तेजी से काले-भूरे हो जाते हैं
सुबह के समय पत्तियों की निचली सतह पर सफेद रूई जैसा फफूंद विकास
खेत में सड़े हुए पौधों की दुर्गंध आना
differential_diagnosis: Late blight lesions are fast-spreading water-soaked patches with white underleaf mold, unlike Early Blight which has dry concentric target rings.
cultural_management: Use certified disease-free seed tubers (e.g. Kufri Girdhari, Kufri Himalini)
High earthing-up to prevent motile zoospores reaching developing tubers
biological_organic_management: Prophylactic spray of Trichoderma harzianum.

symptoms_en: Dark brown to black necrotic spots with characteristic concentric rings (target board pattern) on older lower leaves
symptoms_hi: निचली पुरानी पत्तियों पर गहरे भूरे-काले गोल धब्बे जिनमें गोल चक्र (टारगेट बोर्ड पैटर्न) दिखाई देते हैं
differential_diagnosis: Concentric target rings in dry lesions distinct from water-soaked non-zoned late blight.
cultural_management: Remove and burn lower infected foliage; avoid overhead sprinkler splashing.
biological_organic_management: Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) prophylactic spray.

symptoms_en: Hard, black, crust-like sclerotial encrustations on the skin of harvested tubers resembling dirt that does not wash off
symptoms_hi: कंद की त्वचा पर काले रंग की सख्त पपड़ी या दाने जो धोने पर भी नहीं छूटते
differential_diagnosis: Black encrustations do not affect internal flesh.
cultural_management: Crop rotation with non-host crops and green manuring with Sesbania.
biological_organic_management: Seed tuber treatment with Trichoderma viride.

symptoms_en: Brown to black spots with concentric rings (target board effect) surrounded by yellow chlorotic halo on leaves and stems
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर गहरे भूरे रंग के चक्राकार धब्बे जिनके चारों ओर पीला घेरा होता है
differential_diagnosis: Concentric rings differentiate from bacterial spot and Septoria leaf spot.
cultural_management: Prune bottom 30 cm leaves touching the soil; stake tomato plants.
biological_organic_management: Spray Trichoderma or bio-fungicide formulations.

disease_name_hi: टमाटर का पर्ण कुंचन (लीफ कर्ल वायरस / माथा बंधना)
pathogen: Tomato leaf curl virus (Begomovirus transmitted by Whitefly Bemisia tabaci)
symptoms_en: Upward and downward curling of leaves, puckering, reduction in leaf lamina size, severe stunting and bushy stunted appearance
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों का ऊपर व नीचे की ओर मुड़ना, पत्तियों का आकार छोटा होना, पौधे का बौना व झाड़ीदार होना
differential_diagnosis: Severe curling and leathery thickening transmitted by whiteflies; distinguished from mite feeding by absence of webbing.
cultural_management: Raise nursery under 40-mesh nylon net covers
Eradicate and bury infected virus-reservoir plants in field early
biological_organic_management: Yellow sticky traps @ 15-20/acre to trap whiteflies
Foliar spray of Neem Oil (10,000 ppm) @ 2 ml/L

symptoms_en: Water-soaked dark flattened leathery black spot at the blossom end (base) of developing green tomato fruits
symptoms_hi: टमाटर के फल के निचले हिस्से (ब्लॉसम एंड) पर काला चपटा चमड़े जैसा धब्बा पड़ना
differential_diagnosis: Non-pathogenic physiological disorder caused by Calcium deficiency induced by erratic watering.
cultural_management: Maintain continuous, regular soil moisture; avoid alternate dry and flood cycles.
biological_organic_management: Foliar spray of Calcium Nitrate @ 5g/L at early fruit set.

disease_name_hi: कपास का पत्ता मरोड़ रोग (लीफ कर्ल वायरस)
pathogen: Cotton leaf curl virus (Begomovirus transmitted by Whitefly)
symptoms_en: Upward or downward leaf curling, vein thickening, and enations (small leaf-like cup outgrowths on leaf underside)
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों का मुड़ना, नसों का मोटा होना और पत्ती की निचली सतह पर छोटी पत्ती जैसी गांठें (Enations) बनना
differential_diagnosis: Enations on underleaf veins are the defining diagnostic hallmark of CLCuD.
cultural_management: Grow resistant Bt hybrids; destroy weed hosts like Abutilon indicum (Peeli Booti).
biological_organic_management: Yellow sticky traps for whitefly management.

disease_name_hi: जीवाणु झुलसा / कोणीय पत्ती धब्बा (ब्लैक आर्म)
symptoms_en: Angular water-soaked lesions bounded by leaf veins turning brown-black (Angular leaf spot and Black arm on branches)
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की नसों से घिरे कोणीय (Angular) धब्बे और शाखाओं पर काले घाव (ब्लैक आर्म)
differential_diagnosis: Angular geometric margins bounded by veins.
cultural_management: Delinting and certified seed treatment.
biological_organic_management: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50 WP as per standard package of practices.

symptoms_en: White or creamy raised blister-like pustules on lower leaf surface; staghead malformation in flowering heads
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की निचली सतह पर सफेद या मलाईदार उभरे हुए फफोले और फूल वाली टहनियों का विकृत (Staghead) होना
differential_diagnosis: Chalky white blister pustules on leaf underside.
cultural_management: Timely sowing in October before temperature drops; destroy infected floral stagheads.
biological_organic_management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma.

symptoms_en: Small brown to black circular spots with concentric rings on leaves, stems and developing siliquae (pods)
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों और फलियों पर गोल काले-भूरे छल्लेदार धब्बे
differential_diagnosis: Concentric black spots on pods cause premature seed shattering.
cultural_management: Clean certified seeds; avoid dense sowing.
biological_organic_management: Foliar spray of NSKE (5%).

symptoms_en: Pinholes and large ragged windowpane leaf tears; heavy sawdust-like fecal frass packed inside central leaf whorl
Larva has inverted Y-shape mark on head and 4 square spots on 8th abdominal segment
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों में गोल छेद व कटे-फटे पत्ते, मक्के के पौधे के केंद्रीय पोंगे (Whorl) में बुरादे जैसा मल भरा होना
सूंड़ी के सिर पर उल्टा 'Y' का निशान और 8वें खंड पर 4 चौकोर काले धब्बे
differential_diagnosis: Sawdust-like fecal frass in central whorl and head inverted Y-mark distinct from native stem borer.
cultural_management: Deep summer ploughing; intercropping with cowpea or desmodium.
biological_organic_management: Release of egg parasitoid Trichogramma pretiosum @ 50,000/acre
Whorl application of neem formulation or Metarhizium anisopliae (5g/L)

symptoms_en: Small, elongated rectangular buff-colored necrotic spots between leaf veins with purplish margins
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की नसों के बीच लंबे आयताकार भूरे-जामुनी धब्बे
differential_diagnosis: Rectangular lesions bounded strictly by parallel veins.
cultural_management: Destroy previous maize crop residue.
biological_organic_management: Seed treatment before sowing.

symptoms_en: Sudden drooping of upper leaves, yellowing and drying of entire plant; dark brown to black internal xylem vascular discoloration when stem is split vertically
symptoms_hi: पौधे का अचानक मुरझाना, पत्तियां पीली होकर सूखना; तने को बीच से चीरने पर अंदर की नसें काली-भूरी दिखाई देना
differential_diagnosis: Internal vascular brown browning on split stem is conclusive for Fusarium wilt, distinguishing from dry root rot.
cultural_management: Grow wilt-resistant cultivars (JG 11, Pusa 362, RVG 202)
Deep sowing (8-10 cm) and 3-year crop rotation with sorghum or wheat
biological_organic_management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5-10g/kg seed + soil application of 2.5 kg Trichoderma enriched in 100 kg FYM per acre

symptoms_en: Caterpillar feeds on leaves during early stage and makes round entry holes into developing pods, eating inside seeds while keeping half body outside
symptoms_hi: सूंड़ी द्वारा फलियों में गोल छेद करके अंदर के दानों को खाना, आधा शरीर फली के बाहर लटका रहना
differential_diagnosis: Round circular holes in pods with hollowed grains inside.
cultural_management: Intercropping with coriander or marigold as trap crop
Install T-shaped bird perches @ 20-25/acre to encourage predatory birds
biological_organic_management: Install Helilure pheromone traps @ 5/acre
Spray HaNPV (Helicoverpa Nuclear Polyhedrosis Virus) @ 250 LE/ha or Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt @ 1 kg/ha)

symptoms_en: Interveinal chlorosis on 3rd and 4th upper leaves, bleached white-yellow bands in middle of leaf blade, stunting
symptoms_hi: तीसरी और चौथी ऊपरी पत्तियों की नसों के बीच पीलापन, पत्ती के मध्य में सफेद-पीली धारियां और पौधे का बौनापन
differential_diagnosis: Bleaching of middle leaf lamina without fungal pustules or spots.
cultural_management: Soil test based application of Zinc Sulphate (21% Zn @ 25 kg/ha) basal.
biological_organic_management: Foliar spray of 0.5% Zinc Sulphate + 0.25% unslaked lime solution.

symptoms_en: Rusty-brown / reddish-brown discoloration on younger leaves starting 2-3 weeks after transplanting, stunted root growth
symptoms_hi: रोपाई के 2-3 सप्ताह बाद पत्तियों पर कत्थई/लाल-भूरे रंग के धब्बे दिखना और जड़ों का विकास रुकना
differential_diagnosis: Rusty pigmentation across entire plant patches in alkaline or calcareous soils, not caused by a pathogen.
cultural_management: Basal application of Zinc Sulphate 21% @ 25 kg/ha before last puddling.
biological_organic_management: Foliar spray of 5 kg Zinc Sulphate + 2.5 kg hydrated lime in 500L water per hectare.
